title: Pokemon TCG Seaking Prismatic Evolutions 021/131 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokemon Seaking card from the Prismatic Evolutions set is a Water-type Pokémon card with 110 HP. It features a holo finish and is illustrated by Nelnal. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States, this card is part of the Standard size and is in English language. It is an Uncommon card suitable for players aged 6 and above in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
